title: AERON_flight_model_cooked node extension
description: Written by aeron_gltf_cook, in cooked files only: what it computes for a node of an AERON_flight_model asset. The model root carries renderData and probeData, a component simulationData. Unknown fields are ignored.

vec3.title: Vector
vec3.description: A vector in the Aeron frame (the model frame), in metres for positions.

simulationData.title: Simulation data
simulationData.description: Written by aeron_gltf_cook: the component's collision bounding volume hierarchy. A loader without it builds it, with a warning; stale or malformed data fails the load.

bufferView.title: Buffer view
bufferView.description: The buffer view holding the data.

topologyHash.description: The hash of the simulation topology the data was built from (the collision child's mesh, otherwise the render mesh).

renderData.title: Render data
renderData.description: Written by aeron_gltf_cook: the bounding volume hierarchy of the merged render triangles. A loader without it builds it, with a warning; stale or malformed data fails the load.

bufferView.title: Buffer view
bufferView.description: The buffer view holding the data.

meshHash.description: The hash of the merged render triangles the data was built from.

probeData.title: Probe data
probeData.description: Written by aeron_gltf_cook --probes, in cooked files only: the model's baked probes, with the layout they were baked for, in the Aeron frame and metres. Images that do not match the layout fail the load.

cubes.title: Cubes
cubes.description: The buffer view of a KTX2 array of square BC6H or RGBA16F cube maps with roughness mips, probe k in layer k.

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: The buffer view of a KTX2 image of one RGBA16F level, 6 rx by ry rz texels: point (x, y, z) at column 6 x + f, row y + ry z, the irradiance / pi toward +x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z in RGB, the mean radiance's luminance in A.

size.description: The zone the grid lights fully, its full extent.

gridResolution.description: Points per axis, at (i + 1) / (resolution + 1) of the box.
